physics-killer-05.title: Ukungqubana Nokhuseleko, Ukuphoswa Ngokuthe Tye kunye Nomxhuzulane
physics-killer-05.topic: Ukungqubana Nokhuseleko, Ukuphoswa Ngokuthe Tye kunye Nomxhuzulane
physics-killer-05.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-05.material: Into enobunzima $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ ihamba ngecala $+x$ ngesantya $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Kule nto kusebenza amandla ecaleni $+x$, ubungakanani bamandla bunyuka ngokungatshintshi ukusuka $0$ ukuya $40\,\mathrm{N}$ ngexesha $0\sim0.1\,\mathrm{s}$, bungatshintshi $40\,\mathrm{N}$ ngexesha $0.1\sim0.3\,\mathrm{s}$, kwaye buyancipha ngokungatshintshi ukusuka $40\,\mathrm{N}$ ukuya $0$ ngexesha $0.3\sim0.4\,\mathrm{s}$. Yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa ubungakanani be-impulse efunyenwe yinto ngexesha lale $0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ kunye nesantya sento kanye emva kokuba amandla ecime? (Akukho namandla angawo.)
physics-killer-05.thinking.0: Ukungqubana Nokhuseleko, Ukuphoswa Ngokuthe Tye kunye Nomxhuzulane
physics-killer-05.s.s1.prompt: Into enobunzima $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ ihamba ngecala $+x$ ngesantya $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Kule nto kusebenza amandla ecaleni $+x$, ubungakanani bamandla bunyuka ngokungatshintshi ukusuka $0$ ukuya $40\,\mathrm{N}$ ngexesha $0\sim0.1\,\mathrm{s}$, bungatshintshi $40\,\mathrm{N}$ ngexesha $0.1\sim0.3\,\mathrm{s}$, kwaye buyancipha ngokungatshintshi ukusuka $40\,\mathrm{N}$ ukuya $0$ ngexesha $0.3\sim0.4\,\mathrm{s}$. Yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa ubungakanani be-impulse efunyenwe yinto ngexesha lale $0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ kunye nesantya sento kanye emva kokuba amandla ecime? (Akukho namandla angawo.)
physics-killer-05.s.s1.explain: Indawo: ikona yokuqala $\frac12\cdot0.1\cdot40=2$, isikwere $0.2\cdot40=8$, ikona yokugqibela $2$, ngoko $I=12\,\mathrm{N\cdot s}$. Ukusuka $I=m(v-v_0)$ $12=2(v-4)\Rightarrow v=10\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Ukuba yonke ibonwa njengesikwere $40\cdot0.4=16$, impendulo engalunganga ②, ukuba iinxalenye zekona ziyalityalwa kwaye kusetyenziswa $8$, impendulo engalunganga ③, ukuba $I$ ayahlulwa ngobunzima kwaye kusetyenziswa $4+12=16$, impendulo engalunganga ④.

physics-killer-05.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
physics-killer-05.steps.0.prompt: Into enobunzima $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ ihamba ngecala $+x$ ngesantya $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Kule nto kusebenza amandla ecaleni $+x$, ubungakanani bamandla bunyuka ngokungatshintshi ukusuka $0$ ukuya $40\,\mathrm{N}$ ngexesha $0\sim0.1\,\mathrm{s}$, bungatshintshi $40\,\mathrm{N}$ ngexesha $0.1\sim0.3\,\mathrm{s}$, kwaye buyancipha ngokungatshintshi ukusuka $40\,\mathrm{N}$ ukuya $0$ ngexesha $0.3\sim0.4\,\mathrm{s}$. Yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa ubungakanani be-impulse efunyenwe yinto ngexesha lale $0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ kunye nesantya sento kanye emva kokuba amandla ecime? (Akukho namandla angawo.)
physics-killer-05.steps.0.explain: Indawo: ikona yokuqala $\frac12\cdot0.1\cdot40=2$, isikwere $0.2\cdot40=8$, ikona yokugqibela $2$, ngoko $I=12\,\mathrm{N\cdot s}$. Ukusuka $I=m(v-v_0)$ $12=2(v-4)\Rightarrow v=10\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Ukuba yonke ibonwa njengesikwere $40\cdot0.4=16$, impendulo engalunganga ②, ukuba iinxalenye zekona ziyalityalwa kwaye kusetyenziswa $8$, impendulo engalunganga ③, ukuba $I$ ayahlulwa ngobunzima kwaye kusetyenziswa $4+12=16$, impendulo engalunganga ④.
